necessary_context.content: Nonempty compact convex Θ⊂R^d; f(θ)=E_P F(θ;X), finite on Θ; F(·;x) closed convex for P-almost every x. Paired observations evaluate the same sampled function at two points, with fresh independent X_t across iterations.
necessary_context.name: Standing stochastic convex setting

necessary_context.content: Dψ(a,b)=ψ(a)−ψ(b)−<∇ψ(b),a−b>. Differentiable ψ is 1-strongly convex with respect to ||·||. For a minimizer θ*, Dψ(θ*,θ)≤R²/2 for every θ∈Θ. Initialize at any θ_1∈Θ.
necessary_context.name: Bregman geometry and Assumption A

necessary_context.content: Measurable g(θ;x)∈∂F(θ;x), E g(θ;X)∈∂f(θ); E||g(θ;X)||_*²≤G² uniformly on Θ. In the smooth setting g=∇F and E g=∇f. Lemma 1 retains the pointwise moment rather than requiring a uniform G bound.
necessary_context.name: Gradient selection and Assumption B

necessary_context.content: dom F(·;x) contains Θ+u_1 supp μ for every x∈X. Positive perturbation sizes are non-increasing. Queries may leave Θ; the queried segments must be in the sample-function smooth domain.
necessary_context.name: Query domain and Assumption C

necessary_context.content: Z∼μ independently of X, E ZZ^T=I_d. M=(E[||Z||^4||Z||_*²])^(1/2)<∞. For every a∈R^d, E||<a,Z>Z||_*²≤s(d)||a||_*².
necessary_context.name: Direction law and Assumption D

necessary_context.content: For P-almost every x, F(·;x) has L(x)-Lipschitz gradient in the stated primal/dual norms; L_P=(E L(X)²)^(1/2)<∞.
necessary_context.name: Sample smoothness and Assumption E
